content:
If the Coldcard incident has you reconsidering how you hold your bitcoin, we're hosting a free live multisig workshop on Monday at 4:30pm UTC.

We'll show how you can move from one key to multiple keys across different hardware vendors, what that protects you from, and where the tradeoffs are.

The session will end with a live Q&A to answer any questions or concerns you may have about multisig and your setup.

Register here: https://app.livestorm.co/casabitcoin/getting-started-with-multi-key-vaults
